lines.say: Up, up, down, down, left, right, left, right, B, A, start. This code made Contra famous.
Konami released Contra in arcades in 1987, and on the NES in 1988.
Enter the code on the title screen, and you start with 30 lives instead of 3.
The code first showed up in Gradius, but Contra made it legendary.
The heroes, Bill and Lance, were inspired by 80s action movies like Predator and Rambo.
In Europe, it became Probotector, and every soldier was turned into a robot to get past strict rules in Germany.
Could you beat it without the code? Follow for more 8-Bit Backstory!
